{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module DNSResolver where

import Data.ByteString (ByteString)
import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as C8
import Data.Word (Word8)
import Data.IORef
import System.IO
import Data.List (intercalate)
import Data.Char (ord, chr, toLower)

-- Encrypted storage for DNS cache entries
data CacheEntry = CacheEntry
  { ceHostname :: ByteString
  , ceAddress  :: ByteString
  , ceTTL      :: Int
  , ceNotifyEmail :: ByteString
  } deriving (Show)

data ResolverConfig = ResolverConfig
  { rcAdminEmail :: String
  , rcSmtpRelay  :: String
  , rcCacheRef   :: IORef [CacheEntry]
  }

-- XOR-based storage encryption (simplified for demonstration)
encryptionKey :: Word8
encryptionKey = 0x5A

encryptField :: ByteString -> ByteString
encryptField = BS.map (`xor8` encryptionKey)
  where xor8 a b = fromIntegral $ (fromIntegral a :: Int) `mod` 256
                    `seq` fromIntegral ((fromIntegral a :: Int) `xor` (fromIntegral b :: Int))

decryptField :: ByteString -> ByteString
decryptField = encryptField  -- XOR is symmetric

-- DNS label validation: RFC 1035 compliant
validateDNSLabel :: ByteString -> Bool
validateDNSLabel label =
  let len = BS.length label
  in len > 0 && len <= 63 && BS.all isValidLabelChar label
  where
    isValidLabelChar w = (w >= 0x61 && w <= 0x7A)  -- a-z
                      || (w >= 0x41 && w <= 0x5A)  -- A-Z
                      || (w >= 0x30 && w <= 0x39)  -- 0-9
                      || w == 0x2D                  -- hyphen

-- Normalize hostname: lowercase and validate structure
normalizeHostname :: ByteString -> Either String ByteString
normalizeHostname hostname =
  let labels = C8.split '.' hostname
      normalized = BS.intercalate (C8.singleton '.') (map (C8.map toLower) labels)
  in if all validateDNSLabel labels && not (BS.null hostname)
     then Right normalized
     else Left "Invalid hostname format"

-- Sanitize email for SMTP header inclusion
-- Checks for CR/LF injection in the email address field
sanitizeEmailForHeader :: ByteString -> Either String ByteString
sanitizeEmailForHeader email =
  let localPart = C8.takeWhile (/= '@') email
      domainPart = C8.drop 1 $ C8.dropWhile (/= '@') email
      -- Check the visible characters for obvious injection
      hasVisibleNewline = C8.any (\c -> c == '\r' || c == '\n') email
  in if hasVisibleNewline
     then Left "Email contains invalid characters"
     else if BS.null domainPart
          then Left "Email missing domain"
          else Right email

-- Build notification email when DNS cache is updated
-- Re-validates email after decryption to prevent injection
buildNotificationHeaders :: ResolverConfig -> CacheEntry -> Either String String
buildNotificationHeaders config entry =
  let decryptedEmail = decryptField (ceNotifyEmail entry)
  in case sanitizeEmailForHeader decryptedEmail of
       Left err -> Left $ "Notification blocked: " ++ err
       Right validEmail ->
         let emailStr = C8.unpack validEmail
             headers = unlines
               [ "From: " ++ rcAdminEmail config
               , "To: " ++ emailStr
               , "Subject: DNS Cache Update for " ++ C8.unpack (ceHostname entry)
               , "Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8"
               , ""
               , "The DNS cache has been updated."
               ]
         in Right headers

-- Store a new cache entry with validation
storeCacheEntry :: ResolverConfig -> ByteString -> ByteString -> Int -> ByteString -> IO (Either String ())
storeCacheEntry config hostname addr ttl notifyEmail = do
  case normalizeHostname hostname of
    Left err -> return $ Left err
    Right normHost -> do
      case sanitizeEmailForHeader notifyEmail of
        Left err -> return $ Left err
        Right validEmail -> do
          let encrypted = encryptField validEmail
          let entry = CacheEntry
                { ceHostname = normHost
                , ceAddress = addr
                , ceTTL = ttl
                , ceNotifyEmail = encrypted
                }
          modifyIORef (rcCacheRef config) (entry :)
          return $ Right ()

-- Process cache expiry and send notifications
processExpiredEntries :: ResolverConfig -> IO [Either String String]
processExpiredEntries config = do
  entries <- readIORef (rcCacheRef config)
  let notifications = map (buildNotificationHeaders config) entries
  return notifications

-- No raw entry addition exposed - all entries must go through storeCacheEntry
-- which performs validation. The IORef is internal implementation detail.
